name: dsh-balance-widget
description: Balance & cost widget for the dsh web GUI: a corner icon in the conversation session header that shows the DeepSeek account balance and the current session's estimated spend on click. Host half proxies the official /user/balance API over ctx.webServer (loopback-only); client half renders the icon and popover. Zero external dependencies — works on Node 24.
